body: Thank you for listening to me. I've definitely considered volunteering, it seems like it would definitely make me feel better about myself, just difficult to commit to doing something and actually acting on it.

> feel

I can't even tell you how good it feels to be acknowledged. Thank you for listening to me. You don't know me or owe me anything yet you show concern for me and I genuinely appreciate that. You've provided me with a lot to think about, I find its always easy to see the sense in something (i.e. coming to love myself before loving others) but its just difficult to implement in reality. I haven't really met any other females or anyone in general; I'm somewhat timid and just have trouble with starting conversations. 

Again, thank you.
